title: Pair Encoding Preserves Fan-In Two
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $r$ be a finite bit string, and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $2n+2+|r|$ inputs and gates in topological order, each reading only earlier vertices, with a valid output vertex. Suppose every gate of $C$ has distinct input vertices, every NOT gate has exactly one input, and every gate has at most two inputs. Then the circuit obtained by wiring its inputs to the pair encoding of an $n$-bit input and $r$ also has distinct inputs at each gate, exactly one input at every NOT gate, and at most two inputs at every gate.
